sources.note: 'First Day of Camp: Monday, July 6th, 2026'; brochure says camp runs six weeks, so the sessions are the 6 Mon-Fri weeks from July 6 at the brochure's $230/week. Registration link with tracking parameters removed.

Brochure: 'kids with diabetes, ages 5-14, their siblings, and friends'; 'Camp Welch site, located at 127 North Main Street in Assonet'; 'Camp Jack is $230 per week per camper. Financial assistance may be available'; 'Accredited member of the American Camp Association (ACA)'.
2026 Camper Handbook: bus drop-off/pick-up with bus monitors; 'All campers must bring their own lunch' (pizza provided Fridays only); Camp Welch is an outdoor camp.

This page belongs to the operator, People Incorporated, a multi-service agency. It is not a dedicated camp website. The camp's details are in a brochure that the text doesn't include.

The address and phone number belong to People Incorporated's main office (4 South Main St., Fall River, MA 02721). This may not be where the camp is held, so the camp's location fields were left empty.
The page URL puts the camp under 'diabetes-association-inc', which suggests a camp for children with diabetes. The page text doesn't say so, so no category or special-needs details were recorded.
The registration link had Facebook tracking parameters attached, and these were removed.

description_short: The Jack Rua Camp for Children with Diabetes: a day camp for kids with type 1 diabetes ages 5-14, their siblings and friends, held for six weeks in July and August at Camp Welch in Assonet, MA. Nurses are on site, and activities, snacks and meals are planned around diabetes management.
special_needs_notes: For campers with type 1 diabetes, their siblings/relatives and close friends. A lead RN, an RN and an LPN are on site; blood glucose checks at snack and lunch times; staff trained in type 1 diabetes management.
